evidence.title: REST Admin API reference
evidence.snippet: Starting April 1, 2025, all new public apps must be built exclusively with the GraphQL Admin API .

evidence.title: REST Admin API reference
evidence.snippet: Some newer platform features may only be available in GraphQL .

evidence.title: REST Admin API reference
evidence.snippet: get ( path: 'shop' ) cURL curl -X GET \ https://{shop}.myshopify.com/admin/api/2026-10/shop.json \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -H 'X-Shopify-Access-Token: {password}' Remix const { admin } = await authenticate.admin(request); const response = admin.rest.get({path: 'shop'}); Node.js const client = new shopify.clients.Rest({session}); const response = client.get({path: 'shop'}); Ruby session = ShopifyAPI::Auth::Session.new( shop: 'your-development-store.myshopify.com', access_token: access_token, ) ShopifyAPI::Context.setup( api_key: 'client_id', api_secret_key: 'client_secret', api_version: 'api_version', # Example: '2026-10' scope: 'read_products', is_private: false, # Set to true if you are using a private app is_embedded: true # Set to true if you are using an embedded app ) ShopifyAPI::Context.activate_session(session) client = ShopifyAPI::Clients::Rest::Admin.new( session: session ) response = client.get(path: 'shop') Anchor to Endpoints and requests Endpoints and requests Admin REST API endpoints are organized by resource type.

evidence.title: REST Admin API reference
evidence.snippet: All Admin REST API endpoints follow this pattern: https://{store_name}.myshopify.com/admin/api/2026-10/{resource}.json POST Example POST request Create a new product.
